non_claims: The native Fortran TOV+Love uses a Dormand-Prince RK45 integrator and log-log linear EOS interpolation; the Python reference (m6_tov_love_solver.py) uses scipy DOP853 and PCHIP interpolation, so the two agree to ~7% on R and ~5% on k2 for the same polytrope. The native module is the production backend.
The rapid-conversion Cowling interface (Masuda et al. 2013) is documented but not integrated; only the slow (quasi-static, pressure-corrected) y-jump is implemented.
No M5 Maxwell production output is consumed here; this verification uses synthetic polytropic barotropes. The M5 Maxwell production EOS is consumed by the E390-07 batch orchestrator.
Cowling f-mode oscillation frequencies are NOT computed by this module; the compose_cowling runtime-compile path is a separate subscope (out of scope for this native module).

outputs.native_stellar_interfaces: DELIVERED: native Fortran TOV integration (RK45 adaptive) for smooth and sharp-Maxwell barotropes
outputs.phase_transition_tidal_jump: DELIVERED: Delta y = -4 pi r_d^3 Delta eps / (m_d + 4 pi r_d^3 p_d) applied at the transition radius; two-branch integration verified
outputs.slow_rapid_cowling_interface_receipts: DELIVERED (slow case): Takatsy-Kovacs Eq. 11 pressure-corrected y-jump; rapid case (Masuda 2013) documented as a distinct formula, not integrated here
outputs.tidal_love_solver: DELIVERED: l=2 tidal Love y(r) ODE (Takatsy-Kovacs 2020 Eq. 2-3) integrated with TOV; k2 and Lambda from Thorne 1971 / Eq. 1

physics_contract.eos_interpolation: log-log linear P(eps) per branch (PCHIP in the Python reference; the linear form is the native approximation)
physics_contract.integrator: Dormand-Prince RK45 adaptive (tol=1e-6, h in [dr_max/1000, dr_max])
physics_contract.maxwell_y_jump: Takatsy-Kovacs Eq. 11 (pressure-corrected Postnikov): Delta y = -4 pi r_d^3 Delta eps / (m_d + 4 pi r_d^3 p_d)

publication.backend: Fortran compose_eos_tov module (RK45 TOV + l=2 Love + Maxwell y-jump)
publication.frontend: Python receipt/verification only; no numerical fallback

title: Make TOV/tidal/Cowling production path Fortran-only
